**All data in this project are simulated.**

An end-to-end pipeline on Databricks Free Edition: messy Excel files in, clean Delta tables and tracked models out.

## Pipeline

Excel files, then bronze (raw strings with lineage columns), silver (typed, cleaned, no identifiers), gold (one row per participant), then a scikit-learn model tracked in MLflow.

## Results

| Model | CV AUC | Test AUC |
|---|---|---|
| Baseline | 0.500 | 0.500 |
| Logistic regression | 0.686 | 0.645 |
| Random forest | 0.702 | 0.665 |

A modest result on simulated data. Most of the signal comes from one built-in effect, so this is a workflow demonstration, not a finding.
